segments.source: The Applicative Contract
segments.translation: 애플리커티브 계약

segments.source: Just like {anchorName ApplicativeLaws}`Functor`, {anchorName ApplicativeLaws}`Monad`, and types that implement {anchorName SizedCreature}`BEq` and {anchorName MonstrousAssistantMore}`Hashable`, {anchorName ApplicativeLaws}`Applicative` has a set of rules that all instances should adhere to.
segments.translation: {anchorName ApplicativeLaws}`Functor`, {anchorName ApplicativeLaws}`Monad`, 그리고 {anchorName SizedCreature}`BEq`와 {anchorName MonstrousAssistantMore}`Hashable`을 구현하는 타입과 마찬가지로, {anchorName ApplicativeLaws}`Applicative`에도 모든 인스턴스가 지켜야 하는 일련의 규칙이 있습니다.

segments.source: There are four rules that an applicative functor should follow:
segments.translation: 애플리커티브 펑터가 따라야 하는 규칙은 네 가지입니다.

segments.source: It should respect identity, so {anchorTerm ApplicativeLaws}`pure id <*> v = v`
segments.translation: 항등성을 지켜야 하므로, {anchorTerm ApplicativeLaws}`pure id <*> v = v`입니다.

segments.source: It should respect function composition, so {anchorTerm ApplicativeLaws}`pure (· ∘ ·) <*> u <*> v <*> w = u <*> (v <*> w)`
segments.translation: 함수 합성을 존중해야 하므로, {anchorTerm ApplicativeLaws}`pure (· ∘ ·) <*> u <*> v <*> w = u <*> (v <*> w)`가 성립해야 합니다

segments.source: Sequencing pure operations should be a no-op, so {anchorTerm ApplicativeLaws}`pure f <*> pure x`{lit}` = `{anchorTerm ApplicativeLaws}`pure (f x)`
segments.translation: 순수 연산을 순서대로 실행하는 것은 아무 효과도 없어야 하므로 {anchorTerm ApplicativeLaws}`pure f <*> pure x`{lit}` = `{anchorTerm ApplicativeLaws}`pure (f x)`입니다.

segments.source: The ordering of pure operations doesn't matter, so {anchorTerm ApplicativeLaws}`u <*> pure x = pure (fun f => f x) <*> u`
segments.translation: 순수 연산의 순서는 중요하지 않으므로 {anchorTerm ApplicativeLaws}`u <*> pure x = pure (fun f => f x) <*> u`입니다

segments.source: To check these for the {anchorTerm ApplicativeOption}`Applicative Option` instance, start by expanding {anchorName ApplicativeLaws}`pure` into {anchorName ApplicativeOption}`some`.
segments.translation: {anchorTerm ApplicativeOption}`Applicative Option` 인스턴스가 이 법칙들을 만족하는지 확인하려면, 먼저 {anchorName ApplicativeLaws}`pure`를 {anchorName ApplicativeOption}`some`으로 전개하는 것으로 시작하십시오.

segments.source: The first rule states that {anchorTerm ApplicativeOptionLaws1}`some id <*> v = v`.
segments.translation: 첫 번째 규칙은 {anchorTerm ApplicativeOptionLaws1}`some id <*> v = v`입니다.

segments.source: The definition of {anchorName fakeSeq}`seq` for {anchorName ApplicativeOption}`Option` states that this is the same as {anchorTerm ApplicativeOptionLaws1}`id <$> v = v`, which is one of the {anchorName ApplicativeLaws}`Functor` rules that have already been checked.
segments.translation: {anchorName ApplicativeOption}`Option`에 대한 {anchorName fakeSeq}`seq`의 정의에 따르면 이는 {anchorTerm ApplicativeOptionLaws1}`id <$> v = v`와 같으며, 이것은 이미 확인한 {anchorName ApplicativeLaws}`Functor` 규칙 중 하나입니다.

segments.source: The second rule states that {anchorTerm ApplicativeOptionLaws2}`some (· ∘ ·) <*> u <*> v <*> w = u <*> (v <*> w)`.
segments.translation: 두 번째 규칙은 {anchorTerm ApplicativeOptionLaws2}`some (· ∘ ·) <*> u <*> v <*> w = u <*> (v <*> w)`라는 것입니다.

segments.source: If any of {anchorName ApplicativeOptionLaws2}`u`, {anchorName ApplicativeOptionLaws2}`v`, or {anchorName ApplicativeOptionLaws2}`w` is {anchorName ApplicativeOption}`none`, then both sides are {anchorName ApplicativeOption}`none`, so the property holds.
segments.translation: {anchorName ApplicativeOptionLaws2}`u`, {anchorName ApplicativeOptionLaws2}`v`, {anchorName ApplicativeOptionLaws2}`w` 중 어느 하나라도 {anchorName ApplicativeOption}`none`이면 양변이 모두 {anchorName ApplicativeOption}`none`이므로 이 성질이 성립합니다.

segments.source: Assuming that {anchorName ApplicativeOptionLaws2}`u` is {anchorTerm OptionHomomorphism1}`some f`, that {anchorName ApplicativeOptionLaws2}`v` is {anchorTerm OptionHomomorphism1}`some g`, and that {anchorName ApplicativeOptionLaws2}`w` is {anchorTerm OptionHomomorphism1}`some x`, then this is equivalent to saying that {anchorTerm OptionHomomorphism}`some (· ∘ ·) <*> some f <*> some g <*> some x = some f <*> (some g <*> some x)`.
segments.translation: {anchorName ApplicativeOptionLaws2}`u`가 {anchorTerm OptionHomomorphism1}`some f`이고, {anchorName ApplicativeOptionLaws2}`v`가 {anchorTerm OptionHomomorphism1}`some g`이며, {anchorName ApplicativeOptionLaws2}`w`가 {anchorTerm OptionHomomorphism1}`some x`라고 가정하면, 이는 {anchorTerm OptionHomomorphism}`some (· ∘ ·) <*> some f <*> some g <*> some x = some f <*> (some g <*> some x)`라고 말하는 것과 같습니다.

segments.source: In the fourth case, assume that {anchorName ApplicativeLaws}`u` is {anchorTerm OptionPureSeq}`some f`, because if it's {anchorName AlternativeOption}`none`, both sides of the equation are {anchorName AlternativeOption}`none`. {anchorTerm OptionPureSeq}`some f <*> some x` evaluates directly to {anchorTerm OptionPureSeq}`some (f x)`, as does {anchorTerm OptionPureSeq2}`some (fun g => g x) <*> some f`.
segments.translation: 네 번째 경우에서는 {anchorName ApplicativeLaws}`u`가 {anchorTerm OptionPureSeq}`some f`라고 가정합니다. {anchorName AlternativeOption}`none`이라면 등식의 양변이 모두 {anchorName AlternativeOption}`none`이기 때문입니다. {anchorTerm OptionPureSeq}`some f <*> some x`는 곧바로 {anchorTerm OptionPureSeq}`some (f x)`로 평가되며, {anchorTerm OptionPureSeq2}`some (fun g => g x) <*> some f`도 마찬가지입니다.

segments.source: All Applicatives are Functors
segments.translation: 모든 애플리커티브는 펑터입니다

segments.source: The two operators for {anchorName ApplicativeMap}`Applicative` are enough to define {anchorName ApplicativeMap}`map`:
segments.translation: {anchorName ApplicativeMap}`Applicative`의 두 연산자만으로도 {anchorName ApplicativeMap}`map`을 정의할 수 있습니다:

segments.source: This can only be used to implement {anchorName ApplicativeLaws}`Functor` if the contract for {anchorName ApplicativeLaws}`Applicative` guarantees the contract for {anchorName ApplicativeLaws}`Functor`, however.
segments.translation: 하지만 이것을 {anchorName ApplicativeLaws}`Functor` 구현에 사용할 수 있는 것은 {anchorName ApplicativeLaws}`Applicative`의 계약이 {anchorName ApplicativeLaws}`Functor`의 계약을 보장하는 경우뿐입니다.

segments.source: The first rule of {anchorName ApplicativeLaws}`Functor` is that {anchorTerm AppToFunTerms}`id <$> x = x`, which follows directly from the first rule for {anchorName ApplicativeLaws}`Applicative`.
segments.translation: {anchorName ApplicativeLaws}`Functor`의 첫 번째 규칙은 {anchorTerm AppToFunTerms}`id <$> x = x`이며, 이는 {anchorName ApplicativeLaws}`Applicative`의 첫 번째 규칙에서 바로 도출됩니다.

segments.source: The second rule of {anchorName ApplicativeLaws}`Functor` is that {anchorTerm AppToFunTerms}`map (f ∘ g) x = map f (map g x)`.
segments.translation: {anchorName ApplicativeLaws}`Functor`의 두 번째 규칙은 {anchorTerm AppToFunTerms}`map (f ∘ g) x = map f (map g x)`입니다.

segments.source: Unfolding the definition of {anchorName AppToFunTerms}`map` here results in {anchorTerm AppToFunTerms}`pure (f ∘ g) <*> x = pure f <*> (pure g <*> x)`.
segments.translation: 여기서 {anchorName AppToFunTerms}`map`의 정의를 펼치면 {anchorTerm AppToFunTerms}`pure (f ∘ g) <*> x = pure f <*> (pure g <*> x)`가 됩니다.

segments.source: Using the rule that sequencing pure operations is a no-op, the left side can be rewritten to {anchorTerm AppToFunTerms}`pure (· ∘ ·) <*> pure f <*> pure g <*> x`.
segments.translation: 순수 연산을 순차 실행해도 아무 효과가 없다는 규칙을 사용하면, 좌변을 {anchorTerm AppToFunTerms}`pure (· ∘ ·) <*> pure f <*> pure g <*> x`로 다시 쓸 수 있습니다.

segments.source: This is an instance of the rule that states that applicative functors respect function composition.
segments.translation: 이는 애플리커티브 펑터가 함수 합성을 보존한다는 규칙의 한 사례입니다.

segments.source: This justifies a definition of {anchorName ApplicativeMap}`Applicative` that extends {anchorName ApplicativeLaws}`Functor`, with a default definition of {anchorTerm ApplicativeExtendsFunctorOne}`map` given in terms of {anchorName ApplicativeExtendsFunctorOne}`pure` and {anchorName ApplicativeExtendsFunctorOne}`seq`:
segments.translation: 이로써 {anchorName ApplicativeLaws}`Functor`를 확장하는 {anchorName ApplicativeMap}`Applicative` 정의가 정당화되며, 이 정의에서 {anchorTerm ApplicativeExtendsFunctorOne}`map`의 기본 정의는 {anchorName ApplicativeExtendsFunctorOne}`pure`와 {anchorName ApplicativeExtendsFunctorOne}`seq`를 이용하여 주어집니다:

segments.translation: 모든 모나드는 애플리커티브 펑터입니다

segments.translation: {anchorName MonadExtends}`Monad` 인스턴스는 이미 {anchorName MonadSeq}`pure`의 구현을 요구합니다.

segments.source: Together with {anchorName MonadExtends}`bind`, this is enough to define {anchorName MonadSeq}`seq`:
segments.translation: 여기에 {anchorName MonadExtends}`bind`를 더하면 {anchorName MonadSeq}`seq`를 정의하기에 충분합니다:

segments.source: Once again, checking that the {anchorName MonadSeq}`Monad` contract implies the {anchorName MonadExtends}`Applicative` contract will allow this to be used as a default definition for {anchorTerm MonadExtends}`seq` if {anchorName MonadSeq}`Monad` extends {anchorName MonadExtends}`Applicative`.
segments.translation: 다시 한번, {anchorName MonadSeq}`Monad` 계약이 {anchorName MonadExtends}`Applicative` 계약을 함의한다는 것을 확인하면, {anchorName MonadSeq}`Monad`가 {anchorName MonadExtends}`Applicative`를 확장하는 경우 이를 {anchorTerm MonadExtends}`seq`의 기본 정의로 사용할 수 있습니다.

segments.source: The rest of this section consists of an argument that this implementation of {anchorTerm MonadExtends}`seq` based on {anchorName MonadExtends}`bind` in fact satisfies the {anchorName MonadExtends}`Applicative` contract.
segments.translation: 이 절의 나머지 부분에서는 {anchorName MonadExtends}`bind`를 기반으로 한 {anchorTerm MonadExtends}`seq`의 이 구현이 실제로 {anchorName MonadExtends}`Applicative` 계약을 만족한다는 논증을 제시합니다.

segments.source: One of the beautiful things about functional programming is that this kind of argument can be worked out on a piece of paper with a pencil, using the kinds of evaluation rules from {ref "evaluating"}[the initial section on evaluating expressions].
segments.translation: 함수형 프로그래밍의 아름다운 점 중 하나는 {ref "evaluating"}[표현식 평가에 관한 첫 절]에서 다룬 것과 같은 평가 규칙을 사용하여 이러한 논증을 종이와 연필만으로 풀어낼 수 있다는 것입니다.

segments.source: Thinking about the meanings of the operations while reading these arguments can sometimes help with understanding.
segments.translation: 이러한 논증을 읽으면서 각 연산의 의미를 생각해 보면 이해에 도움이 될 때가 있습니다.

segments.source: Replacing {kw}`do`-notation with explicit uses of {lit}`>>=` makes it easier to apply the {anchorName MonadSeqDesugar}`Monad` rules:
segments.translation: {kw}`do`-표기법을 {lit}`>>=`를 명시적으로 사용하는 형태로 바꾸면 {anchorName MonadSeqDesugar}`Monad` 규칙을 적용하기가 더 쉬워집니다:

segments.source: To check that this definition respects identity, check that {anchorTerm mSeqRespIdInit}`seq (pure id) (fun () => v) = v`.
segments.translation: 이 정의가 항등성을 지키는지 확인하려면 {anchorTerm mSeqRespIdInit}`seq (pure id) (fun () => v) = v`인지 확인하십시오.

segments.source: The left hand side is equivalent to {anchorTerm mSeqRespIdInit}`pure id >>= fun g => (fun () => v) () >>= fun y => pure (g y)`.
segments.translation: 좌변은 {anchorTerm mSeqRespIdInit}`pure id >>= fun g => (fun () => v) () >>= fun y => pure (g y)`와 동등합니다.

segments.source: The unit function in the middle can be eliminated immediately, yielding {anchorTerm mSeqRespIdInit}`pure id >>= fun g => v >>= fun y => pure (g y)`.
segments.translation: 가운데에 있는 unit 함수는 바로 제거할 수 있으며, 그 결과 {anchorTerm mSeqRespIdInit}`pure id >>= fun g => v >>= fun y => pure (g y)`를 얻습니다.

segments.source: Using the fact that {anchorName mSeqRespIdInit}`pure` is a left identity of {anchorTerm mSeqRespIdInit}`>>=`, this is the same as {anchorTerm mSeqRespIdInit}`v >>= fun y => pure (id y)`, which is {anchorTerm mSeqRespIdInit}`v >>= fun y => pure y`.
segments.translation: {anchorName mSeqRespIdInit}`pure`가 {anchorTerm mSeqRespIdInit}`>>=`의 왼쪽 항등원이라는 사실을 이용하면, 이는 {anchorTerm mSeqRespIdInit}`v >>= fun y => pure (id y)`와 같고, 이는 곧 {anchorTerm mSeqRespIdInit}`v >>= fun y => pure y`입니다.

segments.source: Because {anchorTerm mSeqRespIdInit}`fun x => f x` is the same as {anchorName mSeqRespIdInit}`f`, this is the same as {anchorTerm mSeqRespIdInit}`v >>= pure`, and the fact that {anchorName mSeqRespIdInit}`pure` is a right identity of {anchorTerm mSeqRespIdInit}`>>=` can be used to get {anchorName mSeqRespIdInit}`v`.
segments.translation: {anchorTerm mSeqRespIdInit}`fun x => f x`는 {anchorName mSeqRespIdInit}`f`와 같으므로 이는 {anchorTerm mSeqRespIdInit}`v >>= pure`와 같으며, {anchorName mSeqRespIdInit}`pure`가 {anchorTerm mSeqRespIdInit}`>>=`의 오른쪽 항등원이라는 사실을 이용하면 {anchorName mSeqRespIdInit}`v`를 얻을 수 있습니다.

segments.source: In addition to adhering to the individual contracts associated with each type class, combined implementations {anchorName ApplicativeLaws}`Functor`, {anchorName ApplicativeLaws}`Applicative` and {anchorName ApplicativeLaws}`Monad` should work equivalently to these default implementations.

segments.source: In other words, a type that provides both {anchorName ApplicativeLaws}`Applicative` and {anchorName ApplicativeLaws}`Monad` instances should not have an implementation of {anchorTerm MonadExtends}`seq` that works differently from the version that the {anchorName MonadSeq}`Monad` instance generates as a default implementation.
segments.translation: 다시 말해, {anchorName ApplicativeLaws}`Applicative` 인스턴스와 {anchorName ApplicativeLaws}`Monad` 인스턴스를 모두 제공하는 타입은 {anchorName MonadSeq}`Monad` 인스턴스가 기본 구현으로 생성하는 버전과 다르게 동작하는 {anchorTerm MonadExtends}`seq` 구현을 가져서는 안 됩니다.

segments.source: This is important because polymorphic functions may be refactored to replace a use of {lit}`>>=` with an equivalent use of {lit}`<*>`, or a use of {lit}`<*>` with an equivalent use of {lit}`>>=`.
segments.translation: 이것이 중요한 이유는 다형 함수를 리팩터링하면서 {lit}`>>=`를 사용하는 부분을 동등한 {lit}`<*>` 사용으로 바꾸거나, {lit}`<*>`를 사용하는 부분을 동등한 {lit}`>>=` 사용으로 바꿀 수 있기 때문입니다.

segments.source: This refactoring should not change the meaning of programs that use this code.
segments.translation: 이러한 리팩터링이 이 코드를 사용하는 프로그램의 의미를 바꾸어서는 안 됩니다.

segments.source: This rule explains why {anchorName ValidateAndThen}`Validate.andThen` should not be used to implement {anchorName MonadExtends}`bind` in a {anchorName ApplicativeLaws}`Monad` instance.
segments.translation: 이 규칙은 {anchorName ApplicativeLaws}`Monad` 인스턴스에서 {anchorName MonadExtends}`bind`를 구현하는 데 {anchorName ValidateAndThen}`Validate.andThen`을 사용해서는 안 되는 이유를 설명합니다.

segments.source: On its own, it obeys the monad contract.
segments.translation: 그 자체만 놓고 보면 이 함수는 모나드 규약을 따릅니다.

segments.source: However, when it is used to implement {anchorTerm MonadExtends}`seq`, the behavior is not equivalent to {anchorTerm MonadExtends}`seq` itself.
segments.translation: 그러나 이 함수로 {anchorTerm MonadExtends}`seq`를 구현하면, 그 동작은 {anchorTerm MonadExtends}`seq` 자체와 동등하지 않습니다.
